name: Character Transformation Engine — Scientific Reporting & Decision API
endpoints: Create a report snapshot from registered study/analysis artifacts.
Render or register a report section with source artifacts.
Bind claims to supporting, limiting and contradictory graph nodes.
Run report integrity and provenance QC.
Return the report's complete source lineage.
Publish an immutable report snapshot when QC permits.
Supersede a prior report while preserving its history.
publication_gates: source manifest hash matches registered inputs
claim language does not exceed claim status
replication/generalization status is explicitly reported when applicable
language_guardrails: Do not call an association causal without an eligible causal design.
Do not call one study replicated.
Do not describe a generalized result as universal.
Do not turn a model output into direct evidence.
Do not replace unknown values with favorable defaults.
